title: ProCerDCL: Query-Efficient Black-Box Probabilistic Verification of Deep Learning Compiler Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.36499v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present \tool, a query-efficient framework for black-box probabilistic verification. Given a fixed, sampleable input distribution and a binary property oracle, \tool assesses the property's violation probability $p$ against a threshold $\theta$. Under independent sampling and stateless oracle behavior, acceptance asserts $p\le\theta$, rejection asserts $p>\theta+\eta$ for a user-specified separation margin, and an inconclusive verdict indicates insufficient evidence for either conclusion. The probability of each type of erroneous verdict is bounded by its specified error budget. To support this three-valued contract efficiently, \tool uses a single sequential test, eliminating the interval family required by the baseline. The test accounts for repeated sampling checks through either corrected exact binomial confidence intervals or an anytime-valid confidence sequence. We apply \tool to probabilistic local model semantic consistency,

translated_title: ProCerDCL：面向深度学习编译器优化的查询高效黑盒概率验证
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 ProCerDCL，一个查询高效的黑盒概率验证框架。给定一个固定的、可采样的输入分布和一个二元属性判定器，ProCerDCL 针对阈值 θ 评估该属性的违反概率 p。在独立采样且判定器无状态的假设下，接受结论断言 p≤θ，拒绝结论断言 p>θ+η（其中 η 为用户指定的分离裕度），而“不确定”的结论则表示没有足够的证据支持任一结论。每类错误结论的概率均被其指定的错误预算所约束。为了高效支持这种三值判定契约，ProCerDCL 采用单一序贯检验，消除了基线方法所需的区间族。该检验通过修正的精确二项置信区间或任意时点有效的置信序列来处理重复采样检查。我们将 ProCerDCL 应用于概率化的局部模型语义一致性……
tldr: ProCerDCL 提出了一种查询高效的黑盒概率验证框架，利用单一序贯检验在指定错误预算内判定属性违反概率是否超过阈值，并将其应用于深度学习编译器优化的验证。
en_tdlr: ProCerDCL is a query-efficient black-box probabilistic verification framework that uses a single sequential test to decide—within specified error budgets—whether a property's violation probability exceeds a threshold, applied to deep learning compiler optimization verification.
